description: This file defines an enumeration 'MeasurementWindow' representing different measurement time windows with specific durations and resolutions used for monitoring metrics within the system.

classes.name: MeasurementWindow
classes.description: An enum that specifies predefined measurement windows with associated durations and resolutions for metric collection.

methods.name: forName
methods.description: Static method to retrieve a MeasurementWindow enum based on its label name.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the measurement window and its resolution.

methods.name: getWindow
methods.description: Returns the Duration representing the measurement window.

methods.name: getResolution
methods.description: Returns the Duration representing the resolution of measurements within the window.
